pNone_chapter_1: A narrow, dimly lit corridor of a vintage Bengali hotel features a row of dark wooden doors, with a focus on the framed number two. A thin, uniformed hotel bearer stands before the closed door, his hand raised as if poised to knock again on the polished timber. Warm, early morning sunlight filters through a high ventilation window, casting long shadows across the checkered marble floor. To the side, the manager Harishchandra, a middle-aged man in a cotton undershirt and dhoti, watches from a doorway with a focused and questioning expression.
